description: Update a media item: the sort order of any item (lower sort_order appears first), or the URL of a video entry (https YouTube/Vimeo link only). url can only be changed for video entries; for screenshots delete and re-upload. This tool does not create entries: a video is added with set_metadata { video_url }, an image with upload_screenshot. Use get_my_software_details to get media ids. Provide at least one of sort_order/url. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

media_id.description: The id of the media item (from get_my_software_details response)

sort_order.description: Display position; lower values appear first

url.description: New video URL (video entries only; https YouTube/Vimeo)

name: update_media
title: Update a Crela media item
